HOW IT WORKS

Less between you
and the chain.

A data source you can operate, inspect and connect to the tools your team already uses.

⌁

Keep your pipeline current.

Receive new blocks and receipts from peers without L1 or L2 RPC at runtime. Follow live events instead of building your own polling loop.

LIVE GRPC EVENTS
⌘

Know what you are reading.

Check signatures and data commitments. Handle reorgs and late receipts explicitly, with documented limits for safe and finalized labels.

TRUST AND FINALITY ↗
▤

Choose where data lives.

Keep a local archive or serve sealed history from an object-storage fleet. Read columnar batches into your own database and analytics jobs.

ARROW FLIGHT RANGES
YOUR FIRST DATASET

Start small.
Build from there.

Install a node, wait for available blocks, then read a small range with Python. Add live updates when your consumer is ready to handle reorgs.

BlocksTransactionsReceiptsLogs
Run your first query ↗
PYTHON · ARROW FLIGHTDownload example ↗
# Choose ten blocks your node holds.
import pyarrow.flight as flight

client = flight.FlightClient(
    "grpc://127.0.0.1:50051"
)
start, end = 40000000, 40000009
ticket = flight.Ticket(
    f"blocks:{start}:{end}:any".encode()
)
reader = client.do_get(ticket)
for chunk in reader:
    if chunk.data is not None:
        print(chunk.data.to_pydict())
Requires pyarrow + held range · “any” can reorganize
